context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_phase3_generate.py (run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<public_url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_phase3_generate.py -v). Wall time ~5s. Fresh /generate yields ~5-6s solver wall. Iter_4 backend bugs (prefer_dstar_over_star weight=25, non_flexi_overage not enforced) remain unaddressed but were explicitly out of Phase 3 scope.
